paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Lily opened the front door. A small blue box stood on the doorstep. It had an unusual spotted ribbon. A label on the lid said, "FOR LILY AND TOM." "Who sent it?" asked Lily. No-one was in the street. "What a surprise!" she said.

Look at the pictures of the box and the label. Can you guess what is inside? Lily took the box into the living room. Tom and Pip came to look. "It is flat and light, so it might be a book," said Lily. Tom shook the box. "I hear a strange sound," he said. Mia, the girl next door, came into the living room. "It might be a game," she said. "What shape is the box?" she asked. "It is long and flat," said Tom.

"Is there anything on the lid?" asked Mia. "Yes, there is a small stamp," said Tom. "It looks like a bird." Lily pulled the ribbon, and the lid came off. Inside, there were two paper kites. One kite had stripes, and one kite had spots. There was also a card in a white envelope. Tom opened the envelope and read the card. "It is from Aunt Sue!" he said.

The card said, "These are two special kites for two special children. Only Mom knows our secret. Fly them on the hill!" "Mom knew about the box!" said Lily. Pip tried to catch the ribbon. He ran round and round the sofa. Tom and Lily laughed. "The kite with spots is for you," said Tom. "What a good Saturday!" said Lily.
